title: Boundaries in Relationships
summary: Boundaries are the limits that protect your time, body, emotions, privacy and values in a relationship. Healthy partners respect them without punishing you for having them.
steps: Get clear on what you need
Repeat or follow through if it's crossed
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
